limits: Inert loopback proof only; PhysicalDispatchStatus always denies and the package exposes no Send or downstream fencing permit. No automatic production startup or printer activation.

Three voter OS processes plus fourth relay run on one Darwin host with real loopback TCP and separate durable stores. This proves owned-process SIGKILL recovery, not machine power loss, independent host fault domains, or venue LAN qualification.

Actual multi-process replicated primary payload is 600 KiB and other three-voter fixtures use 700 KiB. The 8 MiB full-envelope/chunk/snapshot/cold-restart proof is one voter; no 8 MiB three-voter qualification is claimed.

Pinned synthetic loopback peer/caller fixture trust is not production enrollment, signed-origin forwarding, or live mTLS cluster admission. Terminal-origin production transport integration remains held.
Only the elected leader can claim logical execution. Fixed Device USB jobs are held when that Device is not leader; no nonleader USB forwarding or host failover is implemented.

Controlled nonvoter join/remove is implemented. Live voter-set replacement, durable authenticated client outbox and production enrollment/cutover remain outside this proof; voter counts are explicitly pinned, never inferred from online peers.
Started primary becomes UNCERTAIN without automatic resend. Started optional beep becomes UNCERTAIN and holds same-printer FIFO; no elapsed lease or membership change alone releases it.
ResolveNotPrinted is an audited synthetic operator assertion, not proof that an old executor/native call or buffered bytes were fenced. Physical admission stays denied.
SQLite WAL/FULL and Bolt fsync are verified on task-local files. Network filesystem, actual power-loss media guarantees, Windows service account/driver/hardware behavior need separate qualification.
Bounded retained queue: 128 jobs, 256 requests/configs, 512 attempts, 8 staged jobs, 32 MiB staging, 12 MiB envelope, 64 MiB projection; no production compaction/unbounded queue claim.

Seven Windows test executables are cross-compiled here. Actual Windows guest results, marker-only helper skips and forced TerminateProcess semantics belong to parent receipts, not this compiler receipt.
